title: Area chart
description:
An area chart fills under each series: `x_column` and `y_columns` (or `y_column`,
`series_column`). `stacked: true` piles the series up, `stacked: percent` scales every
x to 100%. Colors are style rules: `series.<label> { color }` here, for every panel.
See `:help dbdash-charts` and `:help dbdash-css`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE m(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM m WHERE n < 12)
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', n * 3 - 2, 3) AS month,
       30 + abs(random() % 30) AS desktop, 40 + abs(random() % 40) AS mobile,
       10 + abs(random() % 15) AS tablet
FROM m

show.title: stacked: true (canvas braille)
show.description:
`stacked: true` piles the series up, each on the one before (ECharts `stack`); the
top line is the total. Braille draws 2 x 4 dots per character.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE m(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n + 1 FROM m WHERE n < 12)

       10 + abs(random() % 15) AS tablet
FROM m

show.title: stacked: percent
show.description:
`stacked: percent` scales every month to 100% (a 100% stacked area): the share of each
series, not its size.

query.sql:

show.title: overlapping (stacked: false), axes.y_axis.max_value
show.description:
Without `stacked` the areas overlap, the first series in front. `axes.y_axis`
`min_value` / `max_value` fix the scale so refreshes do not rescale it.
